changes.to: Only maker statement located: Boston Dynamics' own video release (5 Sep 2012) - 28.3 mph (12.65 m/s) on a treadmill, offboard power, tethered, funded by DARPA. bostondynamics.com/legacy does not list Cheetah, and no maker page, datasheet or spec table exists for it, so mass, dimensions, payload and runtime are left empty.
DARPA-funded laboratory sprinting quadruped that set the 2012 legged-robot speed record on a treadmill.
